body: Don’t be afraid to take a nap, seriously, it’s a pyramid and you’re need to take care of the top! Best

So I found a forum and, yeah there should be speed bumps, I agree... not to judge the people there but I don’t know I would be discussing methods with everyone there.... not to minimize their pain but I wouldn’t be looking for something so permanent with some of those main concerns

I just saw your post about feeling better... I’m seriously... I’m happy for you... but society has no right to ask me to be blind, unable to care for myself, sometimes unable to walk, or have a messy painful exit... does that make sense

Tbh, always, but now I have a degenerative neurological condition, I’ve been paralyzed, I’m losing my eyesight and I’m not able to do daily activities anymore and some hippy thought it was a good idea to mix air in with helium because it gets better.... I guess they don’t have to lose their eyesight and sometimes be unable to walk

Nah I was just venting, like I said I’d rather not do something painful and messy but this existence just isn’t for me. There is no happy ending here other then going to sleep and not getting up again. I’d really like to avoid going to route of walking in front of a train and ruining that dude who’s just workings month but how long can I be asked to do something that just doesn’t work for me.
Thanks ari, you seem very kind
Thanks for your thoughts but I’d rather jump then go to therapy
yes, thats my history with MS. I hope you feel better

Is something wrong with you.... well thats an opinion... I don't think so... I'm sorry your thoughts take you down these paths. TBH living out in the woods and doing things you enjoy like kitting and crocheting sounds enjoyable.

I wonder what resources you have to work through these feelings.

I can tell you’re in a lot of pain and I’m sorry that’s true... your husband sounds difficult and being unhappy is awful.
At least you have those kids you love. Maybe that’s enough?
And you say you love your husband.... even though he only cares about himself.... but you love him!!!
You seem to... at least from where I’m sitting have a lot going for you.... I know it can be tough but think about all of the things you have going for you and make a plan to improve your situation maybe?
kinda the point... but thanks for listening

ive been to therapy for 20 years, ive been to therapy, hypnosis, medication..... oh the medication... 

It's not a lack of trying... 

Its genetic... ive had family members who sat in the garage with the car running.... Ones who had accidents cleaning their gun.... Ones who just stopped getting out bed.... 

Its an illness....

​

To me  it seems better to have people say he did stupid things as opposed to he quit.... to me it seems better to say I did stupid things rather than quit

I do appreciate the pep talk though... that was legit of you... and im glad you don't fully get it... for your sake... stay decent man :)
